latHint: Think a bowl of chicken noodle when you are under the weather.
pivHint: On a farm, STOCK means the animals raised there, such as cattle and sheep. In the kitchen, it is the simmered liquid that soups start from, also called ______.
winText: Simmered to perfection. STOCK was the pivot - farm animals to the flavorful BROTH in a soup pot.
lossText: BROTH - a thin, flavorful soup liquid. STOCK was the pivot: STOCK on a farm means the animals, but in a kitchen STOCK is a simmered liquid used as a soup base, much like BROTH.
